message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have access to live weather feeds right now, so I can’t give you an up‑to‑date forecast for San Francisco. However, here’s what you typically expect:

| Season | Typical Weather |
|--------|------------------|
| **Winter** (Dec–Feb) | Mild temperatures around 8–15 °C (46–59°F), occasional fog especially near the coast, light rain on some days. |
| **Spring** (Mar–May) | Gradually warming, still cool mornings/evenings (~12–17 °C / 54–63°F). Fog less frequent but possible early in the season. |
| **Summer** (Jun–Aug) | Cool evenings due to marine layer—average highs ~20–23 °C (68–73°F); daytime temps often stay under 25 °C because of coastal breezes. Rare heat waves push it higher. |
| **Fall** (Sep–Nov) | Warmest part of the year; highs reach 22–26 °C (72–79°F) before cooling down again toward late fall. |

If you need a precise, real‑time update, checking a reliable weather website or app (like NOAA, AccuWeather, or your phone’s built‑in weather widget) will give you the latest conditions, forecasts, radar images, and alerts.

Let me know if there’s anything else you’d like!
